description: Defines the Transformer module class for PyTorch, including its constructor, forward method, mask generation, and internal components such as encoder and decoder modules.

classes.name: TransformerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Transformer module, including forward pass, mask generation, and parameter reset.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of the Transformer model with source and target sequences and optional masks.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the Transformer module.

methods.name: reset_parameters
methods.description: Initializes or resets the parameters of the Transformer module.

methods.name: generate_square_subsequent_mask
methods.description: Generates a square mask tensor for sequence masking, filled with -inf for masked positions and 0 for unmasked.
